events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest voices in rock history. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: A landmark album that changed everything. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in '65.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember music icon John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost a musical visionary. John Lennon's impact remains immeasurable.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Starman at 80
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Remembering the incredible artistry and influence of David Bowie.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Honoring the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves, Elvis Presley's legend lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: The guitar god himself, Jimmy Page, is 83 today. Still inspiring generations of rock fans.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of rock and pop icon, Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Rod the Mod at 82
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: Our House, His Birthday
angles.copy: Our House is his house today! Suggs from Madness celebrates his 66th birthday.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Every Time You Go Away', Paul Young is 71 today!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Celebrating the 81st birthday of the legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st Birthday
angles.copy: Still working '9 to 5' at 81! Happy birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and pop superstar, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Gary's Birthday Song
angles.copy: He's still got the 'Rule the World' factor! Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a fantastic 77th birthday to the 'Caribbean Queen' himself, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Billy's 77th Wave
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's First Induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Kicks Off
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty officially got its hall. The first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction happened today.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member, Mark Owen.

angles.name: Mark Owen Shines
angles.copy: Still 'Shine'-ing bright! Mark Owen from Take That celebrates his 55th birthday today.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the Apple Corps rooftop in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Rhapsody
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles took to the roof for their iconic final live show. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter Phil Collins.

angles.name: Against All Odds at 76
angles.copy: He's still 'Against All Odds'! Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to the charming British actor, Hugh Grant.

angles.name: Hugh's Charming Birthday
angles.copy: Still charming us on screen! The one and only Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday today.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 46th birthday to pop superstar Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack at 46
angles.copy: He's still bringing 'SexyBack'! Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Sir David Jason, a true legend of British television, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

events.title: The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Remembering Music's Loss
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, the music world lost three stars too soon. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up on Rick
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up! Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: One Love, one legend. Bob Marley would have been 82 today, his music still echoing around the world.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the iconic singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits at 85
angles.copy: From 'Tapestry' to timeless hits, Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: We remember the incredible voice and talent of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That famously announced their temporary split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Take That Heartbreak
angles.copy: Remember the day the world stopped turning for many pop fans? Thirty-one years since Take That's original split announcement.

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red Red Wine for Ali
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and a big birthday! Ali Campbell from UB40 celebrates his 68th today.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran's 36th
angles.copy: From Suffolk to stadium filler! Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Honoring the quiet Beatle, George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Quiet Beatle's 84th
angles.copy: The 'Quiet Beatle' would have been 84 today. Celebrating the incredible songwriting and musicianship of George Harrison.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's iconic frontman, Roger Daltrey.

angles.name: Roger's 83rd Wish
angles.copy: Hope he gets what he wants for his birthday! Roger Daltrey of The Who turns 83 today.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 69th birthday to the 'Wouldn't It Be Good' singer, Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good to wish Nik Kershaw a happy 69th birthday? We certainly think so!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay frontman, Chris Martin.

angles.name: Chris Martin at 50
angles.copy: He's still 'Fixing You' with great music! Chris Martin from Coldplay celebrates his 50th birthday today.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Wishing a rockin' 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi.

angles.name: Livin' on a Prayer at 65
angles.copy: Still 'Livin' on a Prayer' and turning 65! Happy birthday to rock icon Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Remembering the distinctive voice of Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Road to Chris Rea's 76th
angles.copy: Still taking us on a 'Road to Hell' with his incredible music. Chris Rea would have been 76 today.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Honoring Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Baby Love's 83rd
angles.copy: She was 'Baby Love' to millions. Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have been 83 today.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson famously debuted the Moonwalk during his performance of "Billie Jean" at Motown 25.

angles.name: Moonwalk's First Steps
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago, the world saw the Moonwalk for the very first time. Michael Jackson changed dance forever.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Happy 69th birthday to the influential electronic music pioneer, Gary Numan.

angles.name: Are Friends Electric?
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? Gary Numan, the electronic music icon, celebrates his 69th birthday today.
